title: Smartsheet Review (2026)
intro: Smartsheet is evaluated here as a spreadsheet-style / PMO work management platform — Smartsheet is a grid-first work and project platform for teams migrating from spreadsheets into Gantt, dashboards and portfolio control. Pro ~$9/member/mo annual; Business ~$19; Enterprise custom. Strong for PMO/ops buyers who think in sheets — not a lightweight Kanban toy. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s project-management methodology (ease of use, work planning, automation, collaboration, integrations, reporting, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose Smartsheet when spreadsheet-style planning, Gantt and portfolio reporting are the primary job.
verdict: Choose Smartsheet when spreadsheet-style planning, Gantt and portfolio reporting are the primary job. Compare monday/Wrike for Work OS peers, Asana for cross-functional adoption, and Office Timeline for PowerPoint-only decks. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, minimums and usage rates on the vendor site before purchase.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Familiar to spreadsheet natives; less ‘app-like’ than Asana for some buyers.
Sheets + Gantt + portfolios are a strong PMO planning surface.
Automations and proofing workflows solid on Business+.
Comments/proofing good; not a docs-first collaboration suite.
Broad business-system connectors for ops/PMO stacks.
Dashboards and portfolio reporting are a Smartsheet strength — 9.
Enterprise path for large programs and controlled delivery.
Pro $9 is fair for grid PM; Business $19 raises mid-market TCO. Affiliate economics excluded.
AI exists but is not the primary buying reason vs Motion/Notion AI.

limitations: Less ideal for pure Kanban simplicity
pricingSummary: Pro $9, Business $19 per member/mo annual; Enterprise custom. Trial available. Confirm live.

faq.question: Is Smartsheet a project management / work OS tool?
faq.answer: No. Smartsheet is an adjacent desktop workspace organizer. It wraps web apps into desktop shells — it is not a project tracker or work OS.

faq.question: How is Smartsheet priced?
faq.answer: Pro $9, Business $19 per member/mo annual; Enterprise custom. Trial available. Confirm live.

faq.question: Does Smartsheet have a free plan or free trial?
faq.answer: No free plan is published. A free trial is documented (about 30 days). Confirm current terms with the vendor.

faq.question: Did SoftwareGlimpse personally test Smartsheet?
faq.answer: No. This review is based on first-party product and pricing research evidence, not hands-on product usage. Affiliate relationships never influence scores.
